llm-integration.title: LLM Integration 改进
llm-integration.description: Fix streaming correctness, harden error classification, extract shared Responses helpers, declare local capability gaps. Based on verified double-design review (Claude + Codex).

llm-p1-tests.title: Phase 1: Streaming/Retry 测试
llm-p1-tests.description: Add targeted tests before fixing bugs: CloudStreamRetryRunnerTest, CloudStreamRetryPolicyTest, CodexSseParserTest, OpenAIErrorClassifierTest, ChatCompletionClientStreamingTest. Small state-machine tests proving when retry happens, when it stops, when stream is complete/incomplete.

llm-p2-streaming.title: Phase 2: P0 Streaming 正确性修复
llm-p2-streaming.description: 5 fixes: (1) preserve domain exceptions in streamWithRetry, (2) Created event must not block retry, (3) response.incomplete -> Failed, (4) ChatCompletionClient require finishReason, (5) stream-ended throw TransientException. Plus MessageContentExtractor P0 bug fix (feeds Content.toString() garbage to Leap).
acceptCriteria: streamWithRetry preserves RateLimitException and TransientException without reclassification
Created event does not set emittedEvent=true (only TextDelta/ToolCallDone do)
response.incomplete maps to Failed, not Completed
ChatCompletionClient throws TransientException if stream ends without finishReason
MessageContentExtractor deleted, typed extractStringContent used everywhere

llm-p3-harden.title: Phase 3: Classification + SSL + Cancellation 加固
llm-p3-harden.description: 3 fixes: (1) add domain exception and typed SDK exception fast-paths to OpenAIErrorClassifier (no transport-classifier abstraction), (2) gate InsecureSslConfig behind eval-only flag narrower than BuildConfig.DEBUG, (3) store OkHttp Call ref in CodexResponseClient, cancel from awaitClose.
acceptCriteria: OpenAIErrorClassifier.classify preserves existing domain exceptions and checks typed SDK exceptions before string fallback
InsecureSslConfig gated behind eval-only flag, not just BuildConfig.DEBUG
CodexResponseClient cancels OkHttp Call from awaitClose on flow cancellation

llm-p4-responses-helpers.title: Phase 4: 提取共享 Responses Helpers
llm-p4-responses-helpers.description: Extract shared logic from OpenAIResponseClient and CodexResponseClient: request/result accumulation, completion checks, retry epilogue handling. Keep both client classes. Only collapse further if duplication remains.
acceptCriteria: Shared Responses helpers exist for accumulation/completion/retry-epilogue
Both Responses-family clients use shared helpers
No over-engineered strategy pattern unless duplication demands it

llm-p5-local-semantics.title: Phase 5: Local Capability 声明
llm-p5-local-semantics.description: Add narrow LocalLlmSemantics object declaring specific limitations (dropsNonUserAssistantRoles, generatesRandomToolCallIds, noToolResultCorrelation, flattensContentToString). No broad LlmCapabilities framework until second consumer.
acceptCriteria: LocalLlmSemantics object exists declaring Leap limitations
Limitations gated or transformed in one documented place

llm-p6-dedup.title: Phase 6: 去重清理
llm-p6-dedup.description: Extract ToolParameterExtractor from CodexRequestBuilder and LeapToolSchemaAdapter. Shared post-retry flow handler if still needed after Phase 4.
acceptCriteria: No duplicated tool-param parsing in CodexRequestBuilder and LeapToolSchemaAdapter
